requirements.notes: Fully automated at the reducer level. App starts with a single defaulted room; addRoom appends {name:'Room N', 3000×2400} where N = rooms.length+1, leaving prior rooms untouched, and mints ids from a monotonic counter so successive appends get distinct, deterministic ids — both pinned by app-state.test.ts. No upper bound on room count. The '+ Add room' button rendering is manual (ADR-0001), covered by room-input.md TC-1. CR-003 (after removals a new room can reuse a visible 'Room N' label) was reviewed and accepted as cosmetic: ids stay unique so keys/matching are unaffected and the name is immediately user-editable; not a spec violation (DESIGN §5.3 specifies the count-based label).

The disabled/aria-disabled/dimmed remove affordance on the sole remaining room is DOM-level and manual (ADR-0001), covered by room-input.md TC-2.

requirements.notes: Inline validation mirrors the FR-APT-04 pattern: red border (border-err), localized role=alert message directly below each field, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby linking the error id. NOT automated — no React/DOM runner (ADR-0001). Verified by build+tsc+eslint clean, 56/56 tests, and the manual checklist (room-input.md TC-3/TC-4). A11y was directly re-checked by two independent reviewers: the room-name field originally used an sr-only label while the spec/DESIGN §5.4 require a visible label (reported as BOTH CR-002 and SC-001); htmlFor association was always intact, so it was a wording/UX nit, and it was RESOLVED — the name field now renders a visible label identical to Length/Width.
